latest.notes: Fix: overnight stop-set pileup. When the log ran dry (e.g. after the midnight day-rollover stall) the safety net/auto-fill refilled from the Default Clock but also re-added its stop sets on every pass; the live trim strips the refill's music but never stop sets, so breaks accumulated into clusters of back-to-back commercial stop sets in the upcoming log. Automatic refills now add MUSIC ONLY — commercials come only from the real generated day. Manual 'fill from clock' is unchanged.
